# Kairos.ai 優時科技

> AI solutions for the AEC (architecture, engineering, construction) and
> construction industry, starting with AI rebar estimation, plus custom AI
> systems, backend infrastructure, and data platforms. Taiwan-based.

Kairos.ai's first product, SetTime (formerly iTech), converts construction
drawings (PDF or CAD) into accurate rebar estimates and exportable
bar-bending schedules, replacing slow, error-prone manual takeoff. Rebar
estimation is the starting point of a broader mission to bring AI solutions
across the AEC industry. Beyond SetTime, Kairos.ai designs custom AI
systems, backend infrastructure, and data platforms for clients.
